CreateAttackTarget.description_en: Creates an AI Red Teaming scan target (agent or model) and saves its connection configuration for subsequent connectivity tests and scan tasks
CreateAttackTarget.description_zh: 创建一个 AI Red Teaming 扫描目标（Agent 或模型），保存其连接配置供后续连通性测试与扫描任务使用

CreateSkillFileCheck.description_en: Initiates batch detection for user-defined skills
CreateSkillFileCheck.description_zh: 批量发起用户自定义Skill检测

CreateTargetScanTask.description_en: Initiates a security scan task against a scan target that has passed connectivity verification. After the task is created, it is asynchronously prepared and executed
CreateTargetScanTask.description_zh: 对已通过连通性验证的扫描目标发起安全扫描任务，创建成功后任务异步准备与执行

DeleteAttackTarget.description_en: Deletes a specified scan target by TargetId in AI Red Teaming. The target is physically deleted and cannot be recovered. This operation does not stop scan tasks that are in progress
DeleteAttackTarget.description_zh: AI Red Teaming 根据 TargetId 删除指定扫描目标，物理删除且不可恢复；不会停止进行中的扫描任务

DeleteScannerTask.description_en: Physically deletes a specified scan task by ScannerTaskId in AI Red Teaming
DeleteScannerTask.description_zh: AI Red Teaming 根据 ScannerTaskId 物理删除指定扫描任务

GenerateRelayPollerScript.description_en: Generates a one-time installation script for a scan target of the enterprise_relay type in AI Red Teaming. Only Linux platforms are supported. The script contains a one-time access code
GenerateRelayPollerScript.description_zh: AI Red Teaming 为 enterprise_relay 类型的扫描目标生成一次性安装脚本，仅支持 Linux 平台，脚本内含一次性接入码

GetAttackTarget.description_en: Queries the details of a scan target by TargetId for AI Red Teaming, including connection configuration and scan task configuration
GetAttackTarget.description_zh: AI Red Teaming 根据 TargetId 查询单个扫描目标的详情，包含连接配置与扫描任务配置

GetScannerTaskHitDataUrl.description_en: Retrieves a temporary download URL for the attack hit data (hits.csv) of a specified scan task in AI Red Teaming. The URL is valid for 2 hours. An empty string is returned if the data has not been generated
GetScannerTaskHitDataUrl.description_zh: AI Red Teaming 获取扫描任务攻击成功数据（hits.csv）的临时下载链接，链接有效期 2 小时，数据未生成时返回空字符串

GetScannerTaskResultHtmlUrl.description_en: Retrieves a temporary download URL for the HTML result report of an AI Red Teaming scan task. The URL is valid for 2 hours. An empty string is returned if the report has not been generated
GetScannerTaskResultHtmlUrl.description_zh: AI Red Teaming 获取扫描任务 HTML 结果报告的临时下载链接，链接有效期 2 小时，报告未生成时返回空字符串

ListAIAgentEvent.description_en: Retrieves a list of agent risk events

ListAttackTargets.description_en: Queries the list of scan targets for AI Red Teaming. This operation supports multi-dimensional filtering and sorting
ListAttackTargets.description_zh: AI Red Teaming，获取扫描目标列表，支持多维度筛选和排序

ListScanTasksByTarget.description_en: Performs a paged query of scan tasks under a specified scan target for AI Red Teaming. Supports filtering by detection intensity, task status, and scan mode
ListScanTasksByTarget.description_zh: AI Red Teaming，分页查询指定扫描目标下的扫描任务，支持按检测强度、任务状态与扫描模式过滤

StopScannerTask.description_en: Stops (cancels) an in-progress scan task for AI Red Teaming. Calling this operation on a task that is already in a desired state is idempotent and performs no action
StopScannerTask.description_zh: AI Red Teaming 停止（取消）一个进行中的扫描任务；已处于终态的任务调用为幂等无操作

TestConnectivity.description_en: Tests the network connectivity and authentication validity of an AI Red Teaming target
TestConnectivity.description_zh: AI Red Teaming，测试目标的网络连通性和认证有效性
